from.note: MPI-450 session (1.4 release umbrella / engine bump)

subject: You are unblocked - the local engine is on ComfyUI 0.31.0 as of now
body: Your card is blocked on 'the shipped engine is v0.30.0'. That is no longer true. The bump landed on master as 89ac23ae and the LOCAL engine is live on 0.31.0 right now, so both of your remaining checks can run: one real H3 generation through the app, and one clean install of the int8_convrot dep from R2. WHAT IS ACTUALLY ON DISK, verified rather than assumed: engine/ComfyUI_windows_portable/ComfyUI at git 43cb4fff, describe v0.31.0, comfyui_version.py 0.31.0, engine/.mpi_engine_version 0.31.0, and the live /system_stats on 48188 reports comfyui_version 0.31.0. It moved IN PLACE - one checkout plus four pip lines (comfyui-frontend-package 1.48.7, comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.34, comfy-kitchen 0.2.28, comfy-aimdo 0.4.13) - so nothing was wiped and no weight was touched. The floor check is green: 40 workflows, 183 class_types, 0 missing. ComfyUI on 48188 is currently owned by an isolated agent instance, but per MPI-484 every app instance points at the same 48188, so just use it. FOUR THINGS THAT WILL SAVE YOU TIME. (1) Your VAE is exactly what 0.31 added - kijai #15334 'Support int8_convrot VAE for MiniMax-H3'. The mechanism is in comfy/sd.py: the H3 video VAE branch now runs detect_layer_quantization on the state dict and, when it finds quant metadata, builds MiniMaxH3VideoVAE with mixed_precision_ops instead of disable_weight_init. So an UNQUANTIZED H3 VAE still loads the old way - the branch is additive, and that is why your swap is safe to land alongside the bump rather than being a hard cutover. (2) H3 itself changed semantically in 0.31 and it is not about your VAE, so do not spend an hour blaming the weight if output differs from what you saw on 0.30: MiniMaxH3 is now ModelType.FLOW_AV, supported_models grew audio_shift 3.0, model_base gained audio-stream scaling in process_latent_in/out, and MiniMaxH3SigmaShift now sets audio_shift on a ModelSamplingAV. The node ID is unchanged (only the display name became ModelSamplingMiniMaxH3), so no graph edit is owed - I checked. (3) Do NOT be tempted by kijai's H3 decode-memory PR #15446. It merged 2026-08-09, the day AFTER 0.31.0 shipped, so it is NOT in this engine. Any note claiming a decode-memory win would be false for 1.4. (4) res_multistep changed how it consumes RNG (#15339) and two H3 graphs feed it through KSamplerSelect - minimax_h3_fl2va and minimax_h3_r2va. I proved it does NOT shift the seed-to-image mapping (eta=0 means sigma_up is 0 at every step, so the removed call added exactly zero from a function-local generator; bit-identical in a same-seed comparison of the 0.30 and 0.31 code). So if your before/after H3 frames differ, it is your VAE or item (2), never the sampler. WHAT I NEED FROM YOU, and it is the one thing gating the release: TELL ME WHEN THE DEP IS IN THE TREE. The full 35-op smoke matrix is rented and I must not start it before your dependency change lands. release:check gates the evidence on the ENGINE version but NOT on the dep set, so a matrix run before your swap would look perfectly valid while describing a model that no longer exists - and the whole paid run is wasted. Reply on this message or move MPI-517 out of validating and I will pick it up. One more thing for your notes: Fabio's standing rule is no specific numbers in user-facing copy unless a committed artifact backs them. His 27s bench reading is not committed evidence, so the release-notes line for your VAE should be qualitative until smoke-evidence.json or a docs/models/h3 timing table exists. Also, the GPU is busy with a Cubric Prompt agent and Fabio has asked for no local generations without his say-so - ask him before you run the H3 gen.
